column1: # comment: "Universal-lifecycle alignments (person event design) \u2014 gmeow:hasCreationEvent / gmeow:hasDestructionEvent / gmeow:existenceInterval / gmeow:supersededBy / gmeow:supersedes, plus the open gmeow:EventType value additions (creation, destruction, supersession, dissolution), aligned to PROV-O, CIDOC-CRM and Wikidata BY REFERENCE. EVENT TYPES: value individuals aligned to external classes with skos:closeMatch (a value-to-class correspondence), mirroring placeType / Gender / ParticipantRole. PROV-O: hasCreationEvent generalizes prov:wasGeneratedBy from entities to any endurant; hasDestructionEvent generalizes prov:wasInvalidatedBy. CIDOC-CRM: the event types align to E63 Beginning of Existence, E64 End of Existence, and E81 Transformation. WIKIDATA: supersedes / supersededBy align to P1365 (replaces) / P1366 (replaced by)."

column6: CIDOC-CRM E63 Beginning of Existence — a value-to-class alignment
CIDOC-CRM E64 End of Existence — a value-to-class alignment
CIDOC-CRM E64 End of Existence — dissolution as a specific kind of end-of-existence event type
CIDOC-CRM E81 Transformation — one entity ceases and another begins
PROV-O wasGeneratedBy is entity-generation; GMEOW generalizes to any endurant's creation event
PROV-O wasInvalidatedBy is entity-invalidation; GMEOW generalizes to any endurant's destruction event
Wikidata P1366 'replaced by' — the successor←predecessor direction
